# 369 LTD

> 369 LTD is a Dubai-based fintech licensed by Digital Assets Oasis (Ras Al Khaimah). It offers AI-driven crypto analysis, buying and selling of digital assets (including USDT), and Crypto Click Payments for real estate, services and commerce. Tagline: "Where crypto meets reality." Languages: English and Arabic.

## Key facts
- Based at Ground Floor, Office 201, API World Tower, Sheikh Zayed Road, Dubai, UAE (PO Box 414494).
- Serves investors and traders, real estate agencies and developers, businesses and merchants, and institutional partners across the UAE and MENA.
- "369" stands for balance, logic and manifestation.
- Digital assets are volatile. Nothing here is investment advice.
